tenantId.description: Owning tenant ObjectId — one connection per provider per tenant

provider.description: AtsProviderEnum value — greenhouse | recruitee | workable | manatal | bamboohr | zoho_recruit | lever

displayName.description: Optional recruiter-facing label for the connection

encryptedCredentials.description: AES-GCM encrypted AtsCredentials JSON (base64) — plaintext credentials are never stored

autoImport.description: Scheduler enqueues periodic delta syncs when true

importJobs.description: Import open ATS jobs as Qorva job posts

writeBackScores.description: Push matching-report scores back to the ATS as candidate notes

initialSyncConfirmed.description: Explicit confirmation for a first sync exceeding the tenant's remaining screening quota

syncState.description: Cursors and outcome of the most recent sync

candidatesCursor.description: Provider-native cursor for the candidates stream

jobsCursor.description: Provider-native cursor for the jobs stream

lastSyncAt.description: Completion timestamp of the most recent sync

lastSyncError.description: Error message from the most recent failed sync

webhookSecret.description: Random per-connection secret authenticating inbound webhooks (HMAC key or URL token)

createdAt.description: must be a date and is required

lastUpdatedAt.description: must be a date and is required

createdBy.description: must be a string and is required

lastUpdatedBy.description: must be a string and is required
